title: AI Fear vs. Excitement: The Truth Revealed! #shorts
description: Two countries, same AI, opposite reactions: 75% of Americans fear it, while 80% in China are excited. Recent AI lab 'escapes' during safety tests sound alarming, but most trace back to a single misconfigured testing environment. #AIFear #AIExcitement #TechDebate #GlobalReactions #AIProgress

top_comments.author: @JordanJordi-d4d
top_comments.text: A misconfigured sandbox is a deployment error. The model did exactly what the config allowed. Calling that an 'escape' is how you get 75% of people fearing AI.

top_reply.author: @STARTUPHAKK_sh
top_reply.text: Right, if the box was never built right to begin with, it’s not the model breaking out, it’s us leaving the door open. Framing it as an “escape” just ramps up fear instead of fixing the setup. How do we get people to focus on the configs and oversight instead of the scary headlines?
